measurement_scope: Complete ownership checks use synthetic recorded inventories and exclude filesystem record reads, workflow authoring, and scheduling.
Growing checks simulate the two ownership validations per initialization against each successive inventory; public run checks separately measure actual initialization.

Counts observe calls to the unchanged overlap predicate, excluding builtin sorting. Component sorting is O(n log n); adjacent overlap checks are linear for fixed path depth. Repeated initialization retains fresh reads and has O(n^2 log n) aggregate comparison work instead of cubic.
Uninstrumented single-run wall times are supporting measurements from this machine, not portable latency guarantees or regression thresholds.

Public workflow expands from 8 to 16 to 32 Tasks; already completed Tasks are reused. Completion happens in separate workers and is covered by safety regressions, not these frontend comparison counts.
Raw machine-specific logs and probe paths remain under ignored build/validation/ownership-369/. No path substitutions were required in benchmark numeric data.
